This is a test if ROA generators respect the filter6.txt.
All ROA objects with the prefix fdd6:6302:7c04::/48 must
therefore not be included in ROA.
If a ROA generator nevertheless generates route objects
with the prefix, it should not be used.
MARK22K-MNT is responsible for this test.
The following objects are part of the test:
- inet6num/fdd6:6302:7c04::_48
- route6/fdd6:6302:7c04::_48
- route6/fdd6:6302:7c04::_64
- route6/fdd6:6302:7c04:4870::_64
- route6/fdd6:6302:7c04:e500::_56
Outgoing traffic from this network is automatically
triggered by a web crawler. If you would like to stop your
network from being indexed, contact LUTOMA-DN42, create a
robots.txt file, or, as a last resort, block 172.23.13.8/29
The IXP VLAN is fde0:93fa:7a0:2:0::/64 and each AS is allocated fde0:93fa:7a0:2:0:<asn32|high16|hex>:<asn32|low16|hex>::/112 for their nodes (beware the netmask is still /64).
